name: The School of America
source:
A silly game about love in the Whitehouse. You play as Burn (Bernie Sanders) as he tries to obtain the affection of the other candidates, unless he is to face a dark fate. 

[From [url=https://tsa.itch.io/the-school-of-america]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场关于白宫爱情的愚蠢游戏。你扮演伯恩（伯尼桑德斯），他试图获得其他候选人的喜爱，除非他将面临黑暗的命运。

[来自[url=https://tsa.itch.io/the-school-of-america]itch.io[/url]]
